name: Cuddle Quest: Dark Night Cozy Tavern
source:
The sun will be gone for a full month. Can two ponies, one human, and a doll live together? Or will things get weird? They're gonna get weird.

[Edited from [url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/cuddle-quest-cozy-tavern]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
太阳将消失整整一个月。两只小马、一个人和一个洋娃娃可以生活在一起吗？或者事情会变得奇怪吗？他们会变得很奇怪。

[编辑自[url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/cuddle-quest-cozy-tavern]itch.io[/url]]
